consequences: Nobody is misled into thinking a shared item was taken back. Export and import skip private records both ways. sati doctor lists private items so people can see what stays local.
context: Phase 8 lets people keep notes and cards (HR, pay, contracts) off .sati/. Once a record is exported it is in git history, and agent-written text may carry keys.
decision: private: true is chosen when the note or card is made. private: false shares it later; making a shared item private is refused (VALIDATION), because git already has it. Notes, comments and cards go through the secret scanner when saved, naming the field and never echoing the match.
title: Private is set at creation; secrets are refused on write
